author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the release date trailer for Choppa: Rescue Rivals, a globetrotting single-player story campaign developed by Parta Games. Players will pilot their trusty chopper through high-stakes rescue missions from snowy mountains, through a thick jungle, to a burning oil tanker, all wrapped in a Saturday-morning-anime look. Choppa: Rescue Rivals will be released for PC and Nintendo Switch on August 13, 2026.
title: Choppa: Rescue Rivals - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Hard Worker, an open-world online life simulator developed by REGION 23. Players start from nothing, work ordinary jobs, earn money, buy cars and homes, build businesses, and create their own stories together with other players. Unlike most open-world games, there are no guns, no combat, and no violence... just living the simple joys of life - a cozy cottage in the countryside, fishing, or evenings playing an instrument. Hard Worker is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Hard Worker - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the announcement trailer for Dirtnap, a multiplayer arena shooter developed by 
Unstable Entity, Part Time Monkey, and Nitroyal, where the entire battlefield is destructible. In Dirtnap the map  is the weapon. Every tunnel, crater, and firing line is carved into fully destructible, procedurally generated terrain. Players will dig surprise attacks, blast their way out of disasters, and steal wins from impossible positions while water, mud, lava, and fire quietly turn a safe route into a grave. Dirtnap will be available in Steam Early Access in August 2026.
title: Dirtnap - Official Announcement Trailer

title: Black Desert - Official Agent Main Trailer
